test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Phulaich’ festival is celebrated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘**Phulaich**’ festival is celebrated in Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It is celebrated in the month of **September**.
 
• In this festival villagers play drums and go to the mountains to collect flowers named **Larda**.
 
• This festival is celebrated in **remembrance** of the people who passed away.
 
• It is celebrated mainly in the **kinnaur** district of Himachal Pradesh
 
• This festival is celebrated on the **16th** day of the Hindu month of Bhadrapada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Himachal Pradesh has 2 capitals ; one is **shimla** and another one is **Dharamshala**.
 
• **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu** is the current chief minister of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• **Shiv Pratap Shukla **is the current governor of Himachal Pradesh.
